column3: Until ice cream started hating her back.
One cold bite, and a sharp zap shot through her tooth.
Warm water only. Chewing on one side. Fake smiles at every party.
But what was really happening inside her tooth?
Enamel is your tooth's hard shield. But Riya brushed too hard.
Her enamel wore thin, and her gums pulled back.
That exposed the root, full of tiny tubes that lead straight to the nerve.
So cold rushes in, like opening a door in winter.
At the clinic, the doctor found the real cause.
They sealed the exposed spots, and switched her to a soft brush, with gentle circles.
Sensitive teeth are not something to live with. Book your appointment today.
